trend.zh: 本周AI项目集中在视频编辑、图像处理及软件开发自动化领域，体现了AI技术在这些领域的深入应用。Qwen3.8-Max的发布为编码与协作树立了新标准，同时也有研究表明AI能够提供高质量的财务建议。
trend.en: This week, AI projects are clustered around video editing, image processing, and software development automation, reflecting deeper integration of AI in these fields. The release of Qwen3.8-Max sets a new standard for coding and collaboration, while studies also show that AI can provide high-quality financial advice.

deep.zh: 本周AI项目的趋势明显指向了创意工具和生产力增强方向。在视频编辑方面，如JoyAI-Video-Edit等项目展现了通过AI简化复杂编辑任务的能力；图像处理上，多个Hugging Face空间项目如Onise/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-LoRAs-Fast2提供了强大的图像生成与修改功能。软件开发自动化则成为另一大热点，诸如Binaryify/open-kimi-ppt-skill这样的项目致力于通过AI提高开发效率。值得注意的是，尽管AI在许多正面应用中展现出巨大潜力，但也暴露出一些问题，比如Meta投放含有不当内容的广告事件提醒我们在利用AI时必须保持警惕，并确保其使用符合伦理规范。此外，随着Oracle禁止OpenJDK使用AI生成代码的规定出台，未来如何平衡技术创新与版权保护将成为一个重要议题。下周值得关注的是更多关于AI安全性和责任性的讨论，以及是否有新的创新解决方案出现来解决当前面临的挑战。
deep.en: The trend this week clearly points towards creative tools and productivity enhancement. In video editing, projects like JoyAI-Video-Edit demonstrate the ability to simplify complex editing tasks through AI; in image processing, several Hugging Face spaces such as Onise/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-LoRAs-Fast2 offer powerful image generation and modification capabilities. Software development automation has become another major focus, with projects like Binaryify/open-kimi-ppt-skill aiming to increase development efficiency through AI. It's worth noting that while AI shows great potential in many positive applications, it also exposes some issues - the incident of Meta placing ads containing inappropriate content serves as a reminder that we must remain vigilant and ensure its use is ethical. Furthermore, with Oracle's ban on using AI-generated code in OpenJDK, balancing technological innovation with copyright protection will be an important topic moving forward. Next week, more discussions about AI safety and accountability, as well as any new innovative solutions addressing current challenges, are worth watching.

zh.biz: 该工具适用于多种行业，特别是那些需要详细指导的领域，具有较好的市场前景。

en.what: StepShot is an AI tool that turns real workflows into step-by-step guides.
en.why: By converting complex workflows into easy-to-understand step-by-step guides, StepShot helps users better understand and execute tasks.
en.biz: Suitable for various industries, especially those requiring detailed guidance, the tool has good market prospects.

en.what: ShootClip is a tool that uses AI to edit videos 10x faster.

en.biz: As multi-agent systems become more widely used, the framework has high demand in the developer community.

title.en: Qwen3.8-Max: A New Bar for Coding and Cowork

summary.zh: 阿里云发布了Qwen3.8-Max，这是一个新的大语言模型，特别针对编程和团队合作进行了优化。
summary.en: Alibaba Cloud has released Qwen3.8-Max, a new large language model optimized for coding and teamwork.

title.zh: Qwen3.8 Max被Agentic指数评为最佳整体模型
title.en: Qwen3.8 Max Ranked as the Best Overall Model by Agentic Index

summary.zh: 根据Agentic指数的评估，Qwen3.8 Max被评为最佳的整体模型，这表明它在多个关键指标上表现出色。
summary.en: According to the Agentic Index, Qwen3.8 Max has been ranked as the best overall model, indicating its excellent performance across multiple key metrics.

title.en: Oracle Bans AI-Generated Code from OpenJDK

summary.zh: 尽管Ellison声称Oracle不会自己编写代码，但该公司已决定禁止在其开源Java开发套件中使用AI生成的代码。
summary.en: Despite Ellison's claim that Oracle isn't writing its own code, the company has decided to ban the use of AI-generated code in its open-source Java Development Kit.

title.zh: 借助AI，软件开发开始感觉像烹饪牛排一样简单
title.en: Software Development with AI Starting to Feel Like Cooking Steak

summary.zh: 一篇博客文章探讨了AI如何使软件开发变得更加简单，类似于烹饪牛排的过程。
summary.en: A blog post discusses how AI is making software development simpler, akin to the process of cooking steak.

title.zh: 如果问对问题，AI提供的财务建议非常出色
title.en: AI Financial Advice Surprisingly Good, Especially if You Ask Right Questions

summary.zh: 麻省理工学院的研究发现，当用户提出正确的问题时，AI提供的财务建议出乎意料地好。
summary.en: MIT research found that AI-provided financial advice is surprisingly good, especially when users ask the right questions.

title.zh: 人类在4万次游戏运行中错过了三分之一的威胁批准AI代理命令
title.en: Humans Missed 1 in 3 Threats Approving AI Agent Commands Across 40k Game Runs

summary.zh: 一项研究显示，在4万次游戏运行过程中，人类玩家在批准AI代理命令时错过了大约三分之一的潜在威胁。
summary.en: A study revealed that during 40,000 game runs, human players missed about one-third of the potential threats when approving AI agent commands.

title.zh: Meta投放了包含AI生成儿童性虐待图像的广告
title.en: Meta Ran Ads That Contained AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Imagery

summary.zh: 据报道，Meta在其平台上投放了一些包含AI生成的儿童性虐待图像的广告，引发了广泛的争议和批评。
summary.en: It was reported that Meta ran ads on its platform containing AI-generated child sexual abuse imagery, sparking widespread controversy and criticism.
